## How it was tested

## Checklist

- [ ] Nothing about SteamVR is assumed: layouts and formats come from the headers, from SteamVR's own files, or are checked at run time
- [ ] The pose path stays free of allocation, file access and blocking calls
- [ ] Unknown or broken input makes the pose pass through untouched
- [ ] README status table and CHANGELOG are still true
